ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Geographies of Modernism. Special Instructions: Graduate section. Undergraduates must enroll in the ARTH 491. Enrollment is restricted to students accepted into the Illinois at the Phillips Collection program in Washington D.C. This seminar will consider how ideas of geographyøand of places imagined as physical spaces as well as political spheresøhave been transformed in the last century. Indeed, asking not only what, but where, was Modernism, we will investigate questions of site-specificity, identity, globalization, and cultural production and assimilation. Topics will additionally comprise public art, community-based art, and landscape art, among others.
